decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program remains a low-cost option close to the mental health core and its own page signals continued commitment while demand uncertainty resolves.
The custom-furniture carpentry workshop has moderate workshop costs and still uncertain demand, but the dedicated page and related production know-how make it worth holding as an option.
Outpatient sociotherapy is a cheap pilot very close to established care, so the firm keeps the option open while learning about demand.
The senior-living counseling service appears on the home page and fits the eldercare strategy closely, giving it high option value and very low drop risk.
The sheltered-workshop retail shop remains mission-aligned but peripheral and only mentioned, so its higher operating uncertainty raises the drop probability though it is still held as an option.
Meal delivery for seniors is close to the firm's eldercare offer but logistically costlier and only mentioned, so it is kept as a pilot while demand uncertainty resolves.
